intro: No account or identity documents are needed. Your plans and optional spending calculations run on your device. Separate online tools explain what they send before you submit.
assurance: No account needed. Saving your plan on this browser is optional.
title: How each tool handles your information
plansText: These follow the Remember setting below. Saving is off by default. Anyone using this browser may see information you choose to save.
daily: Spending amounts and everyday question choices
dailyText: These stay only in this open page, even when Remember is on. Clearing your Lift plan also clears them. Copied text and downloaded files remain outside Lift.
onlineText: These have separate notices. Read the notice before submitting anything. They need internet access.
